what_differs: On Sep 1 Lina asked for, and Kobi agreed to, an Ops-first override of the matrix payout amount using a 'payout amount differs' / new payout amount pattern (like Deposit Amount Differs, WAGR-266). No build ticket exists; WAGR-465 lists it only as an open question ('Can Ops override a Sign-Up's payout amount? (Lina, Sep 1)'). The related internal check that Payout Amount is read-only for reps (L2277) is also not tracked.
suggested_action: Create a Sign-Up story for the Ops payout amount override (checkbox + override amount, Ops-only FLS, payout batch uses the override) and include the rep read-only check; or confirm with Lina whether the Sep 25 payout design replaces it.
